class.name: SuperposSpawner
class.brief_description: Native receiver spawner that projects canonical replicas into local scenes.
class.description: Attaches the bounded native replica receiver to a configured [SuperposSession] and instantiates scenes admitted by its [SuperposSpawnCatalog]. Canonical native state publishes atomically. Scene projection runs afterwards on the owner thread and is sequential: setters can observe a completed field prefix, and no atomic-scene claim is made. Every construction, setter and tree insertion revalidates native identities, the Session binding generation and a generation-checked projection ticket before continuing. A leave received while construction is pending cancels that construction, and late callbacks cannot resurrect it. A bound replica that has not received its initial canonical state within the spawn readiness timeout (15 seconds by default) is marked timed out. If that state arrives later, canonical state is still applied, but the scene projection is held in the failed phase with a timeout error until [method SuperposReplicaView.retry_projection] is called. Retirement invalidates the projection ticket before a scene node is deleted. When retirement reenters from the root's own constructor, setter or tree callback, deletion of that root is deferred until the callback has returned. Freeing an attached spawner without [method stop] transfers the Session's network to the native retirement queue. No scene destruction or user callback runs from the spawner destructor. All methods are main-thread and owner-thread only. GDScript, C# and C++ call the same native ClassDB implementation.

method.name: get_replicas
method.description: Returns at most [param limit] new weak views of canonical-ready replicas, starting at row [param offset]. [param limit] cannot exceed 64. No scene scan or global World lookup occurs.

method.name: project_pending
method.description: First marks pending constructions whose spawn readiness timeout has expired, then projects at most [member projection_budget] pending replicas. Returns [code]error[/code], [code]timed_out[/code] (newly expired constructions), [code]completed[/code] and [code]failed[/code]. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] while a projection is already running or the spawner is stopping, and [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] when not started. After [method start], the spawner also calls this from process notifications.

method.name: read_rpcs
method.description: Takes at most [param maximum] (at most 64) authority RPCs, each a Dictionary with [code]handle[/code], [code skip-lint]rpc_id[/code], [code]ownership_revision[/code] and [code]payload[/code]. A call is delivered only for a Ready replica whose schema declares it. Calls that arrive before their replica is ready wait in a pre-readiness buffer of at most 64 calls and 64 KiB; beyond that the newest call is dropped and counted, and buffered calls expire after 15 seconds. A call whose replica retired before it is taken is discarded. Counters are in [method SuperposSession.read_receiver_status] under [code]rpc[/code].

method.name: read_status
method.description: Returns [code]error[/code], [code]canonical_ready[/code], [code]scene_ready[/code], [code]scene_failed[/code], [code]spawn_timed_out[/code], [code]spawn_timeout_ms[/code], [code]stopping[/code], [code]owned_native_bytes[/code] and [code]scene_projection[/code]. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] when not started.

method.name: start
method.description: Snapshots the catalog, reserves every native row, proxy, slot and projection cell, and attaches the receiver to [member session]. Accepted integer keys are [code]authority_epoch[/code], [code]connection_epoch[/code], [code]replica_epoch[/code], [code]peer[/code], [code]maximum_active[/code] (at most 1000), [code]maximum_transitions[/code] (at most 64), [code]control_channel[/code], [code]state_channel[/code], [code]bulk_channel[/code], [code]native_bytes[/code] (at most 64 MiB), [code]spawn_timeout_ms[/code] (1 through 60000, default 15000) and [code]rpc_channel[/code] (default 3: a reliable ordered application channel distinct from the replication channels). Unknown keys, including atomic-scene requests, return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. The spawner must be inside the scene tree.

method.name: stop
method.description: Cancels pending constructions, retires every projected node and detaches the receiver with bounded work. Returns [constant OK] when the receiver is fully detached, or when nothing is attached. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] when called from a Session callback or while the Session is closing. The stop then remains requested: projection stays halted, canonical state keeps tracking the receiver, and the spawner retries the stop from process notifications. Old [SuperposReplicaView] resources become stale.

members.member: Catalog snapshotted by [method start]. It cannot be changed while started.
Maximum projections per [method project_pending] call, in the range 1 through 64.
Receiving Session. It cannot be changed while started.
